Quick technical sketch ahead of the call (attached: tilt_sla_proposal_v1.pdf). High level options we usually recommend for a staggered uplift:

- Phase 1 (pilot, 30 days): Priority support + 2x reserved concurrency on critical routes, intelligent KV prefix caching for checkout flows. Expected p99.9 improvements: ~25–35% with minimal price impact.
- Phase 2 (90 days): Dedicated capacity pool (reserved GPUs), regional pinning for primary region, oncall retainer. Tackles tail spikes during promos. Price impact materializes here (we'd provide ARR delta).
- Phase 3 (opt-in): SLA with punitive credits and guaranteed latency envelope (p99 < X ms) — requires thorough load testing and a short-term commitment on capacity.

Notes: moving to a premium SLA will require updated capacity reservations in our Dedicated product; we can offer a phased pricing schedule and a one-time migration/onboarding credit to smooth the transition. Ben, can you prepare sample numbers for both 12-month and 24-month commits?
